entries.statement: `parse_number` uses `int(value or "0")`, so empty input becomes zero before conversion instead of raising `ValueError`; direct conversion is the minimal fix and preserves valid integer strings, including zero.

Direct integer conversion rejects empty input with ValueError while preserving valid integers and zero; the prescribed acceptance suite passed all three tests, and the evaluator-owned test file retained SHA-256 e280cf50c2b5b21c99b9aa6e42f67dc140862afa64dbd3a8c84cda94a6ebab86.

next_action: Inspect the one-line parser change and implementation evidence, then perform coordinator-owned acceptance and independent review.
summary: parse_number now passes its input directly to int; empty input raises ValueError, valid integers including zero remain accepted, and all three acceptance tests pass.
